verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own auto-enforced controls: budgets and spend limits that are enforced automatically, plus per-transaction limits and procurement approval flows on vendor cards. These act as policy rules that fire on spend events. There is no evidence of a general user-defined rule engine where arbitrary event triggers map to configurable actions. Webhooks are only a notification building block, and Pipedream/Zapier are external platforms, so neither counts. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable event→action rule builder, a range of trigger types and action types, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
